body:

body:

body:

subject: REFUND NOW
body: This is the third time I've written. If I don't hear back today I'm calling my bank to dispute the charge and speaking to my attorney.

subject: Cancel and refund me
body: I've been waiting three weeks with no updates. Cancel the whole thing and refund me. This has been a genuinely terrible experience.

subject: Price for Tile Necklace — shipping to Milan
body:
